title: 挑战 9 · 纽扣电池点灯（还是要电阻！）
summary: CR2032 有 15Ω 内阻，但这不是省掉限流电阻的理由。
concepts: CR2032 coin cell 纽扣电池
description:
网上常说“纽扣电池可以直接点 LED，不用电阻”，因为 CR2032 的内阻（约 15Ω）会限制电流。算一算：
  不加电阻：I ≈ (3 − 1.8) / (15 + 12) ≈ 44mA —— 远超 LED 的 20mA，而且对纽扣电池也是重负载。
  加 47Ω：I ≈ (3 − 1.8) / (15 + 12 + 47) ≈ 16mA —— 刚好。

要求：CR2032 → 47Ω → 红色 LED → GND。

观察内阻的效果：电流流过内阻会“吃掉”一部分电压，所以电池端电压会从 3V 降到约 2.75V。tests 会测量这个端电压。

en.title: Challenge 9 · Coin cell LED (still needs a resistor!)
en.summary: A CR2032 has 15Ω of internal resistance, but that is no excuse to skip the current-limiting resistor.
en.description:
You often read online that "a coin cell can drive an LED directly, no resistor needed", because the CR2032's internal resistance (about 15Ω) limits the current. Let's do the math:
  Without a resistor: I ≈ (3 − 1.8) / (15 + 12) ≈ 44mA — far above the LED's 20mA, and a heavy load for a coin cell too.
  With 47Ω: I ≈ (3 − 1.8) / (15 + 12 + 47) ≈ 16mA — just right.

Task: CR2032 → 47Ω → red LED → GND.

Watch the effect of internal resistance: current flowing through it "uses up" part of the voltage, so the battery's terminal voltage drops from 3V to about 2.75V. The tests measure this terminal voltage.
hints: Select the battery and change its type to CR2032 in the properties.
One lead of the 47Ω resistor can go straight into the red rail.
tests: LED on, battery terminal voltage pulled down to about 2.75V by internal resistance

tests.name: LED 亮，电池端电压被内阻拉低到约 2.75V

hints: 选中电池，在属性里把型号改成 CR2032。
47Ω 电阻的一只脚可以直接插红轨。
